info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Participants-v4-spec
info.description: The Meeting Participants Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about participants in various meetings. This endpoint is essential for applications that require insights into attendee lists for event management or analytics purposes. Developers and organizations involved in scheduling and managing meetings will find this API particularly useful for integrating participant data into their systems. By calling this endpoint, consumers can efficiently retrieve participant details associated with specific meetings.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of participants in meetings.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about all participants currently involved in scheduled meetings. It provides essential information to help manage and coordinate meeting attendance effectively.
